items.rows: up to 18 rows; row i at y = 0x55 + 12*i (FIXED, not offset by n); x origin = panelX (entry x = 0)
items.build: from g_goods_list 0x010DFE40 (goods available to the city, in that order), skipping 15 Horses and 22 Chariot: [-1 header] + goods with trade status 5 (importing), [-2 header] + status 7 (exporting), then status 9 (not traded), no header; padded with -3 (stop). Trade status = 0x01607EC4[g*0x18] (docs/logic/empire.md). If no importing goods the -1 header is omitted; if no exporting goods the -2 header is omitted.
